BiblicalUsage: Jathniel was the fourth son of Meshelemiah, a Korhite doorkeeper of the house of the LORD. He stands in the list of the porters with his brothers Zechariah and Jediael and Zebadiah.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the doorkeepers of God's house are honoured, and Jathniel's place at the gate is a place of trust.
